topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh, what a delightful morning! I just learned something quite unexpected. It turns out there won’t be a surprise party for me after all! Now, I know you might think that's a bit odd to be so bright about, but think of the possibilities. Today is free to be whatever I wish. Perhaps a leisurely stroll in the park, or a morning spent with that book that’s been calling my name. Every moment is a gift, especially when it opens up like this, unscripted and full of promise. The day is mine, and oh, how the sun shines!
